premise: Zeph Einstein, an elderly magician honored for a lifetime of Crimson magic, discovers with a new assessment spell that Crimson was his weakest talent. He devises time magic to return to his younger self and, with the prodigy mage Milly and the swordswoman Claude, sets out to master magic the efficient way.
life_message: A good life comes from knowing your real strengths and spending your time on them wisely.
